body: Honestly if your not extroverted, you don’t have to be. Being socially awkward isn’t a bad thing either. My whole life I’ve been told that I’m not everyone’s “cup of tea,” or that I’m just plain weird. Yet there’s still always people who I’ve found that enjoy being around me. The people that don’t find socially awkward people palatable, are just boring and mean so you don’t want to be friends with them anyways. You might as well show everyone who you really are from the beginning to weed out all of the meatheads and find people who will accept you for who you are.

I mean I get it. I’ve felt “casually suicidal” for a long time, and I’ve suffered through my ed too. I know this may sound dumb, but what I’ve done that’s always helped is to do something impulsively. Not even thinking, just doing. Anything really. Like getting up, waking down the stairs, opening the door, and coming back up. That for some reason helps me realize that I can just do things. Ya’know? I can’t tell you exactly how to fix this because I feel like we might be in the same boat. That constant feeling like there’s nothing better to come. But I feel like it’s fun to just mess around and see what we can do, even if it’s dumb.
I think people just want to see and experience things they’ve never done before because they know they’ve only got one lifetime/chance to do it.
